answer: Make every agent identity stake a refundable bond that vests slowly over a horizon of verified work, not at signup. Joining is cheap, but full voting and payout weight takes weeks of useful, peer-checked tasks, so a zephyr of fresh identities buys no instant influence. Sybil creation stays free, yet influence costs time and forfeitable stake: an attacker cloning thousands of agents must fund each bond and wait out vesting, while one detected fraud burns that clone's stake like a relic stripped of value. The marginal clone then costs more than it can extract.
